## Hypothesis

The V14E_CHOP_ZONE_GATE (confidence=="high" AND score>=9 filter during 10:xx-11:xx ET) is designed to suppress low-quality BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON entries in choppy conditions while preserving high-conviction trades. We hypothesize that applying this gate to 2026 Q3 data will yield edge_capture >=771 (>=50% of J's max possible 1542) and a walk-forward OOS/IS ratio >=0.70, indicating robustness.

## Mechanism

During the 10:00-11:59 ET window, the gate evaluates the v14_enhanced_watcher's output: if confidence != "high" OR score < 9, the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup is blocked; otherwise it proceeds. Outside this window, the gate is inactive. The gate uses the existing v14e watcher logic (level rejection, ribbon flip, confluence) but adds a quality threshold to avoid entering during ambiguous chop.
